{{Quote|Alert, interesting information leaked from Empire. Subject Erran Sif, known Rebel. This individual was in fact a spy for the Empire sent to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance. Imperial agents gave us her identity after learning that she sold Rebel AND Imperial information to the Hutts.|A [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] report about Erran Sif|<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>}}
'''Erran Sif''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was considered a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], but was in fact wanted by both sides.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Her identity exposed, she has fled from Corellia to Talus. Our spies indicate she is in the vicinity of 2150 - 5625. Beware, she's hooked up with a mercenary crew that includes a number of scary Trandoshans and along with Erran's two brothers: Hirsch and Doak, two very powerful soldiers.|A Bothan Spynet report about Erran Sif|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
[[File:ErranOffice.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Erran Sif in her bunker]]
Erran Sif began her career as a spy for the Empire. She was instructed to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance, but upon doing so, Imperial agents learned that she was selling both Rebel and Imperial information to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. When her treachery was revealed after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Erran Sif realized that her life was at risk and fled from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="10HSTG" /> There, she holed up in a secluded [[Sif bunker|bunker]], surrounding herself with only her most trusted associates.<ref name="SWG:ES" /> They consisted of a ruthless [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] crew, including a number of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and her two brothers, [[Hirsch Sif|Hirsch]] and [[Doak Sif|Doak]].<ref name="10HSTG" /> However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Empire finally discovered the location of Erran Sif's secret hideout and exposed her identity so that she could be hunted down by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] or other denizens. The [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] also shared this information.<ref name="10HSTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erran Sif was one of many [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ES" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players could go to her bunker and kill Erran Sif, though this was not part of a quest.<ref name="SWG:ES" /> The biography of Erran Sif was expanded upon in a short article titled "[https://web.archive.org/web/20111124000932/http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/players/guides.vm?id=60003 10 Hot Spots Travel Guide]."<ref name="10HSTG" />
